ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of the Ningxia region, and it can be seen that rivers/water system lines within the region pass near the main agricultural area; the map also marks precipitation lines such as 200mm and 400mm, indicating that the annual precipitation in this region is not abundant. Then reason: the question restricts the inquiry to the agricultural advantage “in terms of water sources,” so it should be judged from water source conditions. Flat terrain belongs to terrain conditions, and abundant light resources belong to light conditions, neither of which fits “in terms of water sources”; the precipitation lines in the figure show that local precipitation is relatively low, so the answer cannot be “abundant precipitation.” Agriculture in Ningxia’s “Jiangnan beyond the Great Wall” mainly relies on irrigation from water sources such as the Yellow River, so the advantage in terms of water sources is sufficient irrigation water sources.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：图中是宁夏区域示意图，可见有河流/水系线穿过主要区域，旁边还标出200mm、400mm等降水量线，说明该区降水并不算丰沛。再读题干文字：原题给出的农业优势条件包括“地势平坦、光照资源丰富、降水丰沛、灌溉水源充足”，当前问题限定为“在水源方面”的优势。将“水源方面”与选项含义对应，排除地形、光照等非水源条件，又因图中降水量线显示当地降水偏少，不应答“降水丰沛”，所以应答“灌溉水源充足”。
